The [case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd), which presents the original study, SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and the replications on which the course is built, is the place to start.

::: {.callout-note title="In preparation"}
The design of this course is settled and its material is being built: the slides of the three days, the scripts that build the analysis file from the raw files, and the reproduction of each of the five reanalyses. Until they are ready, the pages of the course link to the material that exists, and the [slides page](slides.qmd) shows the deck of the earlier three-day course.
:::

This is the three-day course on the EU-frames case, a study of Eurobarometer surveys in the *European Sociological Review*, which asked whether the economic crisis changed how citizens of the European Union frame the Union. The course starts from scratch and takes the claim of the original author (OA) from the raw data to a preregistered analysis of your own. Day 1 introduces open research and the infrastructures on which it rests, the aims and the methods of SCORE and Multi100, and the paper in detail, and ends with the tools installed and the data downloaded. Day 2 teaches R and an IDE on the data of the case, builds the analysis file from the raw files as an exercise in data management, and reproduces the result of one of the five reanalyses, chosen by each participant, with the time to understand every line of the code that produced it. Day 3 turns to robustness: the choices that lie between the data and a result, the multiverse of 864 specifications on the curve of the claim, and an analysis of your own design, preregistered before it runs and added to the class chart.

| | What happens | Length |
|---|---|---|
| [Before the course](before.qmd) | Read the case study and the paper; create the account that the raw files need. | 2 to 3 hours |
| [Day 1 – Open research and the case](day-1.qmd) | Credibility and the three Rs, repositories and data sources, SCORE and Multi100, the paper in detail; then the tools installed and the data downloaded. | Four sessions |
| [Day 2 – Tools and the reproduction](day-2.qmd) | R and the IDE on the data of the case, the analysis file built from the raw files, and the reproduction of one of the five reanalyses, reported and sent to the class. | Four sessions |
| [Day 3 – Robustness and the multiverse](day-3.qmd) | The estimand statement and the causal graph, the specification menu and the methods behind it, an analysis of your own design, preregistered, run and placed on the curve. | Four sessions |
| [After the course](after.qmd) | Where to go next in the companion curriculum. | as you like |
